biggest_catch: Your friend must keep their new checking account open for at least six months with a $25 minimum balance and set up $200+ direct deposit — if the account closes early, the bonus can be debited back.
catches: Referred person must: be a new OCCU member, open a new checking account with at least a $25 minimum deposit using new money, set up direct deposit of at least $200, and keep the account open for a minimum of six months with at least a $25 balance.
There is no limit to the number of referral bonuses you can earn — unlimited referrals.
Your friend must use your personalized referral link when opening their account; only current OCCU members can refer.
$100 referral bonus deposited into your OCCU account; bonuses typically paid within 60 days once all requirements are met.
OCCU also donates $25 to a local charity of your choice per qualifying referral (funded by OCCU, not deducted from your bonus).

steps: Get your personalized OCCU referral link.
Share the link with friends and family.
Your friend uses your link to become a new OCCU member and open a qualifying checking account (Momentum or Pop Checking) with at least $25 of new money.
Your friend sets up direct deposit of at least $200 and keeps the account open for at least six months with a $25 minimum balance.
Your $100 referral bonus is deposited into your OCCU account (typically within 60 days); your friend also receives $100, and OCCU donates $25 to a local charity of your choice.
